title: Hiroshima and Miyajima on the pass: the floating torii at high tide · grilled oysters · Peace Park · Hassho okonomiyaki · Dreamination · Shinsekai kushikatsu and Spa World

stops.name: Kujō House
stops.plan: Out at 05:25 with passports and the JR Kansai-Hiroshima Area Pass (day 2 of 5); seats for 8 reserved together in advance.
stops.transport: Osaka Metro Chūō line Kujō 05:40 → Hommachi, Midōsuji line → Shin-Osaka 06:01, about 37 min

stops.name: Sakura 741 Shin-Osaka → Hiroshima
stops.plan: Sanyo Shinkansen Sakura 741, Shin-Osaka 06:25 → Hiroshima 07:57, on the pass (reserve 8 seats together when you exchange it; Mizuho 601 at 06:00 → 07:25 is the earlier backup, also covered); ekiben or konbini breakfast on board.
stops.transport: JR Sanyo line Hiroshima 08:21 → Miyajimaguchi 08:49 (pass), JR Miyajima ferry 08:59 → the island at 09:09 (pass), walk to the shrine, about 88 min with the group (the 08:11 local is only 14 min after arrival, too tight for 8)

stops.name: Itsukushima Shrine & floating torii (Miyajima)
stops.plan: Spring tide: high water 09:29, so you arrive with the torii standing in the sea (it floats about 07:30–11:30); walk the shrine corridors over the water, then the shoreline photo spots.

stops.name: Miyajima Omotesandō
stops.plan: Grilled Hiroshima oysters at Kakiya and the stalls, fresh momiji manjū and a cold beer on the shopping street.
stops.transport: JR Miyajima ferry 12:37, JR Sanyo line → Nishi-Hiroshima, Hiroden tram to Dobashi and walk into the Peace Park, about 95 min

stops.name: Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum & Park
stops.plan: The museum's permanent exhibits (web ticket recommended; the 16:30–18:00 slots need advance booking, we are well before), then the Cenotaph and the Flame of Peace.
stops.transport: Walk north across the park to the Dome, 8 min

stops.name: Atomic Bomb Dome
stops.plan: Outside view of the Dome from the riverbank; a quiet moment before the evening.
stops.transport: Walk east along Hondōri to Yagenbori, 14 min

stops.name: Okonomiyaki Hassho
stops.plan: In the queue by 16:40 for the 17:00 opening; crispy-noodle Hiroshima okonomiyaki on the teppan, expect two tables of four. Fallback: Okonomimura in Shintenchi, 5 min away.
stops.transport: Walk west to the Dreamination lights on Peace Boulevard, 12 min

stops.name: Hiroshima Dreamination lights on Peace Boulevard
stops.plan: Walk the light sculptures on Peace Boulevard (Dreamination runs 4 Dec–24 Jan, lit 17:30–22:30), then to the station.
stops.transport: Taxi, 2 cars, to the Hiroshima Station Shinkansen entrance, 12 min (the tram would only reach the station at 19:01, too tight for the 19:06)

stops.name: Nozomi 58 Hiroshima → Shin-Osaka
stops.plan: Nozomi 58, Hiroshima 19:06 → Shin-Osaka 20:31, on the pass (it covers Nozomi and Mizuho on this stretch); 8 seats together. Backup: Nozomi 60 at 19:21 → 20:46.
stops.transport: Osaka Metro Midōsuji line Shin-Osaka → Dōbutsuen-mae, walk into Shinsekai, about 35 min

stops.name: Kushikatsu Daruma
stops.plan: Second dinner of kushikatsu and highballs; order the full round as soon as you sit (last orders around 22:00, closes 22:30), and no double dipping.

stops.name: Tsūtenkaku & Shinsekai neon walk
stops.plan: Photos under Tsūtenkaku and the Shōwa neon of Shinsekai on the way to the baths (the deck is not needed tonight).

stops.name: Spa World
stops.plan: An hour on the Asian and European themed bath floors; out by 23:30 for the 23:47 JR loop train, before the midnight surcharge, with USJ rope drop tomorrow. No tattoos allowed.
stops.transport: JR Loop line Shin-Imamiya 23:47 → Nishikujō, then to Kujō, about 32 min
